senses.gloss: to be smooth, soft; trnsf. to be discouraged, to despair (cmp. מָסַס).
units: Gen. R. s. 44 (ref. to תשתע, Is. XLI, 10) היה לבו … אל תשתע … לא תָשׁוּעַ his heart was soft as wax, and the Lord sent him two angels …; to this refers what is written al tishtʿa …, be not soft (despair not); Yalk. ib. 115 אל תָּשׁוּעַ אל יהא לבך לשעוה be not soft, let thy heart not turn into wax (cmp.
<cite ref="Psalms 22:15">Ps. XXII, 15</cite>); <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 65">Gen. R. s. 65</cite>; (<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 313">Yalk. Is. 313</cite> <he>אל תירא ואל תשתע</he>).

senses.gloss: [to smooth,] to card, hackle.—Part. pass. שׁוּעַ, pl. שׁוּעִים, שׁוּעִין.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 9:8">Kil. IX, 8</cite>, a. e., v. <cite ref="N00336"><he>נוּז</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 9:9">Ib. 9</cite> <he>לבדים … מפני שהן ש׳</he> felt clothes (of mixed material) are forbidden, because they are carded. Y. ib. IX, end, 32ᵈ <he>הוינן אמרין הא שָׁע מותר</he> we might have thought, but if one cards (wool and linen together), it is permitted; v. <cite ref="U01650"><he>שַׁעַטְנֵז</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: to make slippery, cause to slip (cmp. חָלַק).
units: Gen. R. s. 77 end (expl. ותקע, Gen. XXX, 6) שִׁיְּיעָהּ (or שַׁיְּיעָהּ Chald.; not שייעא; ed. Wil. שעייא, read: שַׁעֲיָיהּ, v. שְׁעֵי) he (the angel) made it (the hollow of the thigh) slip (be dislocated); Cant. R. to III, 6; Yalk. Gen. 132 שעייה (not שת׳), v. supra.
